title: Switching List tabs quickly shows only the last tab's work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • View: on Work Orders the List is shown (click List in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar; its tooltip reads "List").
  • Needs no test data of its own (the site has work orders on every tab).

Setup

  1. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > List shows the tabs All, Estimates, Work Orders, Completed.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Estimates, Completed, Work Orders and Completed again as fast as you can.
  3. Wait for the List to finish loading.
  4. Read the rows and look for any error message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only the Completed tab's work orders show (every row reads Complete or a later status, as the Completed tab shows today).
  • No error message appears.
  • Requests the page stops on the way are a developer check. This part cannot be checked by hand; write 'not checked by hand' in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §2; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§1 Business Case). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §2: “Switch tabs quickly.”
  • QA handoff §2: “no error toast appears, and only the last tab's rows show.”
  • PRD §1 Business Case: “List remains the default and stays exactly as it is in production today; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the switcher that offers the two new displays.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
